vo.en: Look at me. Pick a color.

visual.description: Extreme close-up of a man's intense eye staring directly into the lens with a flickering light effect.

vo.en: Don't overthink it. Just grab the first one that pops into your head.

visual.description: Fast-paced montage of a man's hands shuffling a deck of cards with high speed and motion blur.

vo.en: Now, double the intensity of that color in your mind. Imagine it filling the entire room you’re sitting in.

visual.description: Slow motion shot of vibrant red ink dropping into clear water and spreading aggressively.

vo.en: Wait, I can see you trying to change your mind. Stay focused. Don't switch it now.

visual.description: A serious man in a suit points directly at the camera with a stern, knowing expression.

vo.en: Most people try to be unique, but your brain follows predictable neural shortcuts I've secretly triggered.

visual.description: High-tech motion graphics showing glowing blue neural pathways or digital circuit connections moving rapidly.

vo.en: Right now, you are picturing a bright Red Triangle. Did I just catch you?

visual.description: A glowing red neon triangle pulsing against a pitch-black background.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow’s brain test and comment YES if this worked. You can't help but...
